issue: Log statements use log.Error for informational/debug logging during normal operation instead of log.Debug, which should be reserved for actual error conditions
Logging the entire ids array could result in very large log entries (up to 32767 items), impacting performance and log storage - should remove the ids field or limit to just the count
String concatenation in a loop using fmt.Sprintf is inefficient for large batches - should use strings.Builder for better performance when constructing comma-separated list of IDs
Comment about SQLite parameter limit of 999 is only accurate for versions before 3.32.0 - should clarify this is for compatibility with older versions since modern SQLite has a default limit of 32767
Cleanup job ticker interval changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, but cleanup job has 9-minute timeout, causing overlapping cleanup jobs to run concurrently leading to resource contention
